definition: A point geometry: a latitude and longitude pair in decimal degrees, as in the WISE spatial data tables.
A date in the format yyyy-mm-dd.
A whole number.
A whole number of 0 or more.
A non-negative number. The unit, where there is one, is in the unit column of the field.
A value in the interval [0, 100].
A Gregorian year.
A range of values, written as in the PostgreSQL range types following ISO 80000-2, for example [2028,2033] for the years 2028 to 2033 included. A bound left empty is open, for example [,2036].
A yes or no answer.
A character string of at most 4 000 characters, UTF-8 encoded.
A character string of at most 100 characters, UTF-8 encoded.
A character string of at most 250 characters, UTF-8 encoded.
Text of at most 254 characters.
A character string of at most 255 characters, UTF-8 encoded.
A character string of at most 1 000 characters, UTF-8 encoded.
An e-mail address, at most 250 characters, validated with a regular expression.
A web address, starting with https:// or http://.
A web address, at most 2 100 characters, validated with a regular expression.
A WISE identifier of at most 42 characters, starting with the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, as defined for the WISE reporting of the Water Framework Directive.
A wiseIdentifier identifying a document of the documents dataset.
A wiseIdentifier identifying a place within a document of the documents dataset, for example a chapter or a bookmark.
A file uploaded to Reportnet 3, at most 100 MB, as pdf, xlsx or docx.
A three-letter language code of the ISO 639-2 vocabulary of the Eionet Data Dictionary (common/iso639-2), for example eng.
A value of the INSPIRE ZoneTypeCode vocabulary. The value for an agglomeration under the Directive is still to be agreed.
